label: rem:betti-numbers-brane
title: Betti numbers of the brane tower
html: Let b_k(\mathcal{S}_n) = \dim H^k(\mathcal{S}_n, \mathbb{R}) denote the k-th Betti number of \mathcal{S}_n. Since \mathcal{S}_{n+1} is the bundle of orthonormal frames of J^1 \mathcal{S}_n, the Leray--Serre spectral sequence of the fibration \mathcal{S}_{n+1} \to \mathcal{S}_n determines the Betti numbers of \mathcal{S}_{n+1}. The quantum characteristic classes obstruct the collapse of this spectral sequence, controlling the growth of b_k(\mathcal{S}_{n+1}) relative to b_k(\mathcal{S}_n).
